name: Warframe: The Shadowgrapher
summary: Update 42: The Shadowgrapher is a WARFRAME update released on March 25, 2026. This update adds the Follie warframe, a new game mode set in the destroyed Vesper Relay, Awakening quest remaster, new Adversary weapons, addition of Requiem Eterna relics, more items to purchase with Riven Slivers, additional Honorias, as well as more remastered Operator and Drifter faces.
